purpose: Semantic, source-adoption and public Agent analysis policy for the single reachable OpenHands Workspace source closure.
precedence: source-policy constraints override any KEEP_AS_IS interpretation from source reachability.

categories: frontend API and foreign Agent Runtime integration
Git, repository, terminal, editor, and coding tools
Cloud, Enterprise, Sandbox, and desktop-shell integration

constraints: source content only from the server-validated public_analysis tool argument
provider reasoning_content never crosses the runtime boundary
collapsed by default and expanded only by user intent
same project and session authorization as Research Thread
exclude from share snapshots, export and formal Artifact renderers
never synthesize reasoning in the browser
never expose credentials, transport bodies or unfiltered internal errors
public_step_analysis.local_contract: RunEvent reasoning Activity with a stable activity_id and running/completed phases

agent_activity.lifecycle: one logical operation evolves in place by activity_id; started/completed duplicates are forbidden
agent_activity.reasoning_trace: ReasoningTrace remains a formal evidence-linked Artifact and is distinct from step-level public_analysis.
